page.overview:
Who is Jix?

Jix was a female Human who served a Starfleet officer during the mid-23rd century.

During the Klingon War of 2256-57, she served in a Mobile Combat Surgical Unit on J'Gal under Commander Buck Martinez. She operated the transporter pad during the Battle of J'Gal. ()
